However, immediately after the Offin Canal market stretch, traffic flow improves considerably towards Ijora Olopa by the NEPA intersection.

Along Broad Street, traffic is moving steadily towards Apongbon underneath the bridge, facilitating connections to the Offin Canal market and Olowogbowo areas. Eko Bridge also reports good traffic movement inward towards Apongbon, connecting efficiently with CMS.

Currently, there are no reported impediments, and personnel are present to manage traffic flow effectively.

This steady flow continues towards Onikan, descending towards the Flag House en route to the CMS Bridge and subsequently connecting to Apongbon.

The Apongbon Bridge descending towards Outer Marina and inward to CMS, leading to the Train Station, is also currently reporting good traffic flow. From the Nitel junction towards the State House, traffic moves appreciably through the McWen Bridge by Officers Mess down to Bonny Camp.

For those ascending the Obalende Bridge towards the Dolphin intersection, Emergency point and further inward to Ilubirin, traffic flows smoothly down to the Carter Bridge exit. This allows for a good connection back to the 3rd Mainland Bridge for those journeying inward Iyana Oworo. 
No impediments are currently reported, and our officers are actively managing traffic flow.
